scenes.say: Lakshmi noticed her grandfather had stopped reading the newspaper. He said it was just old age. It wasn't.

scenes.en: After 60, the eye's lens gets stiffer and cloudier. Eye pressure can rise without pain.
scenes.say: After sixty, the lens inside the eye becomes stiffer, and slowly cloudier. Pressure inside the eye can also rise, often with no pain at all.

scenes.en: Poor vision is linked to more falls in older adults.
scenes.ta: பார்வை குறைந்தால் முதியவர்கள் விழும் அபாயம் அதிகம்
scenes.say: Did you know? Studies show poor vision is linked to more falls in older adults. Good light on steps and corridors really helps.

scenes.en: Eye test every year. Sugar and BP in control. Bright light at home.
scenes.ta: வருடம் ஒருமுறை கண் பரிசோதனை, சர்க்கரை, BP கட்டுப்பாடு
scenes.say: So Lakshmi made a simple checklist. An eye test every year. Sugar and blood pressure under control. Bright lights at home, especially near steps.

scenes.en: Glare at night, faded colours, bumping into things, holding things very close.
scenes.ta: இரவில் கண்கூச்சம், நிறம் மங்குதல், பொருட்களில் இடித்தல்
scenes.say: Watch for glare at night, colours looking faded, bumping into things, or holding things very close to read.

scenes.en: Sudden vision loss, a painful red eye, or a shadow over vision
scenes.ta: திடீர் பார்வை இழப்பு, கண் வலி: உடனே கண் மருத்துவரிடம்!
scenes.say: See an eye specialist the same day for sudden loss of vision, a painful red eye, or a dark shadow over the vision.

scenes.en: Book an eye test for your parents today.
scenes.say: Now Thatha reads his paper every morning. Book an eye test for your parents today.
